title: Computational portraits of the tumoral microenvironment in human breast cancer.
authors: Wu, Dongling; Hacking, Sean M; Chavarria, Hector; Abdelwahed, Mohammed; Nasim, Mansoor
journal: Virchows Archiv : an international journal of pathology
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习分析乳腺癌肿瘤微环境的组织学图像，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Breast cancer is the most diagnosed cancer in humans. In recent years, myxoid and proportionated stroma have been described as clinically significant in many cancer subtypes. Here computational portraits of tumor-associated stromata were created from a machine learning (ML) classifier using QuPath to evaluate proportionated stromal area (PSA), myxoid stromal ratio (MSR), and immune stroma proportion (ISP) from whole slide images (WSI). The ML classifier was validated in independent training (n = 40) and validation (n = 109) cohorts finding MSR, PSA, and ISP to be associated with tumor stage, lymph node status, Nottingham grade, stromal differentiation (SD), tumor size, estrogen receptor (ER), progesterone receptor (PR), and receptor tyrosine-protein kinase erbB-2 (HER-2). Overall, MSR correlated better with the clinicopathologic profile than PSA and ISP. High MSR was found to be associated with high tumor stage, low ISP, and high Nottingham histologic score. As a computational biomarker, high MSR was more likely to be associated with luminal B like, Her-2 enriched, and triple-negative biomarker status when compared to luminal A like. The supervised ML superpixel approach demonstrated here can be performed by a trained pathologist to provide a faster and more uniformed approach to the analysis to the tumoral microenvironment (TME). The TME may be relevant for clinical decision-making, determining chemotherapeutic efficacy, and guiding a more overall precision-based breast cancer care.
abstract_zh: 乳腺癌是人类中诊断最多的癌症。近年来，黏液样和比例化间质已被描述为多种癌症亚型中具有临床意义。本研究利用机器学习（ML）分类器，通过QuPath从全切片图像（WSI）中创建肿瘤相关间质的计算图像，以评估比例化间质面积（PSA）、黏液样间质比例（MSR）和免疫间质比例（ISP）。该ML分类器在独立训练队列（n = 40）和验证队列（n = 109）中得到验证，发现MSR、PSA和ISP与肿瘤分期、淋巴结状态、诺丁汉分级、间质分化（SD）、肿瘤大小、雌激素受体（ER）、孕激素受体（PR）和受体酪氨酸蛋白激酶erbB-2（HER-2）相关。总体而言，MSR与临床病理特征的相关性优于PSA和ISP。高MSR被发现与高肿瘤分期、低ISP和高诺丁汉组织学评分相关。作为一种计算生物标志物，高MSR更可能与Luminal B样、HER-2富集和三阴性生物标志物状态相关，而非Luminal A样。本文展示的监督ML超像素方法可由训练有素的病理学家执行，为肿瘤微环境（TME）分析提供更快速、更统一的方法。TME可能对临床决策、确定化疗疗效以及指导更全面的基于精准的乳腺癌护理具有相关性。
